title: Playboy Magazine September 1992 Sandra Bernhard Starkers
descriptionText:
Vintage Playboy Magazine, September 1992 -- Sandra Bernhard "Bunny Wanna-Be" pictorial, Betty Friedan 30th Anniversary interview, Dennis Miller, flight attendants pictorial.

Condition/defect disclosure: there is a vertical crease running down the front and back cover (see photos) -- please review carefully before purchasing. Interior pages otherwise intact.
